title: Sri Ramalayam Reconstruction
description: The proposed reconstruction of Sri Ramalayam is currently in the planning and decision-making phase. Community discussions, planning, fundraising, and approvals are underway. This is a significant project for the village, and collective participation from all villagers will help move it from planning to execution. Once the necessary approvals, resources, and commitments are in place, construction will begin.

milestones.title: Planning conversations begin
milestones.description: Elders, the temple committee, and villagers open discussions about the future of Sri Ramalayam.

milestones.title: Community coordination
milestones.description: Village-wide conversations continue on needs, priorities, and how everyone can contribute.

milestones.title: Critical decision stage
milestones.description: The project remains in planning — awaiting collective commitments, fundraising clarity, and formal approvals before any construction begins.

summary: Community planning and discussions are currently underway.
